name: Platt Scaling
tagline: Per-class sigmoid calibration: fit logistic A·f+B in log-odds space against Platt's smoothed targets, then renormalise across classes.
diff_from_baseline: Platt 1999. Classical sigmoid calibration originally developed for SVM scores; standard 2-parameter binary calibrator extended to one-vs-rest for multiclass.

name: Temperature Scaling
tagline: Single learnable temperature T applied to softmax logits, fit by NLL on the calibration set.
diff_from_baseline: Guo et al. 2017 (ICML). Single-parameter post-hoc calibration that preserves accuracy; standard NN calibrator and modern default for deep classifiers.

name: Isotonic Regression
tagline: Non-parametric monotonically-increasing piecewise-constant fit per class via PAV; renormalised across classes.
diff_from_baseline: Zadrozny & Elkan 2002 (KDD). Non-parametric monotone calibration via Pool-Adjacent-Violators; flexible but data-hungry, prone to overfit small calibration sets.
